_comment: jungle-packs + pack-formations (Docs/JunglePacks.md): challenge packs as jungle mobs. tiers[i]: abilities = non-basic abilities each pack monster uses ("full" = its complete kit), health / damage = per-tier multipliers on the challenge-mob stats below, gold = multiplier on every pack kill's bounty, unlockRound / unlockWave = when authored packs of that tier first appear (round = match cycle; 1 / 1 = from the start, so every authored pack spawns). stats: baseDamage (every role), tankHealth, the other roles' health as shares of the tank's, and the global multipliers (live in F8 > Packs and the layout editor; SAVE writes this file). formations: the preset formation per pack size 3..8 (Eric's pack-formations.png), each slot a role (tank / healer / dps) at forward (toward the pack's facing, the front) and right, in formation units (1 = one monster spacing, about half the pack radius in cm). kitFloor: every pack unit's complete kit is topped up to at least this many abilities from its race (so T4 > T3). leader.healthMultiplier: the pack's first tank leads it. families: creatures outside every race borrow abilities from this race (they only appear in Mixed packs). exclude: never in packs (non-combat bonus creatures).
